没戴棒球帽了，头发是深棕色的短寸，五官轮廓明确，颧骨高，眼窝深，嘴唇薄。标准的高加索面孔，跟白天那个“亚洲混血雪糕佬”判若两人。

一米八五左右。

他的目光落在顾承安身上，扫了一遍。

然后看向面包车和雪糕车的碰撞点上。

“撞到了？”他说的是英文。

顾承安装作用蹩脚的英文回道：“SOrrySOrry……我倒车没注意……你看看坏掉的地方需要多少，我赔……”

他一边说，一边往前迈了一步，伸手指向保险杠凹陷的位置，身体前倾——

马克·西蒙的视线下意识跟着他手指的方向略微低头看了一眼。

就这一眼。

顾承安动了。

左手从裤兜里抽出来的速度比他嘴里含混的语句快了十倍不止——五指箍住对方后颈，拇指精准压在延髓两侧，同时右脚向前跨出半步，膝盖顶进对方大腿内侧，破坏重心。

马克·西蒙的反应确实快——身体在被触碰的第一个零点几秒就开始向后撤，右手肘同步向外顶，试图打开距离。

但顾承安更快。

基因的巅峰体质不是一个抽象概念，它意味着每一块肌肉纤维的收缩速度、每一个关节的发力强度，都被优化到了生物极限。

马克·西蒙的肘击打在空气上——因为顾承安的身体已经贴了过去，他整个人像钉子一样钉进了对方的防御空隙，右臂从下方穿过对方腋下，反手锁住肩关节。

一秒钟都没到。

马克·西蒙就被面部朝下的压在了雪糕车车身上。

顾承安腾出右手，从系统空间里掏出常备的老朋友——乙醚毛巾直接捂上口鼻。

对方一边憋着气，一边不停的反抗。

专业素养真高，普通人被捂住口鼻的第一反应是挣扎呼吸，但受过训练的人会先憋气，避免吸入挥发性药物。

顾承安早就料到了。

他没有着急，对方在他的全力压制下，动弹不得，右手把毛巾严丝合缝地贴在对方的鼻腔和嘴巴上，然后等。

人能憋气多久？普通人三十到四十五秒，体能好的能撑一分钟出头。

但一分钟之后呢？

生物本能会接管一切，横膈膜会不受控制地收缩，空气——以及空气中的乙醚——会被强制吸入肺部。

再加上顾承安腿膝狠狠地戳着他的腰子。

最终坚持了不到三十秒。

马克·西蒙的身体痉挛了一下，接着剧烈抽搐了两次，随后像被抽空了骨架一样软了下去。

He is no longer wearing a baseball cap, his hair is dark brown and short, his facial features are clearly defined, his cheekbones are high, his eye sockets are deep, and his lips are thin.The standard Caucasian face is completely different from the "Asian mixed-race ice cream man" during the day.

About 1.85 meters.

His eyes fell on Gu Chengan and scanned it over.

Then look at the collision point between the van and the ice cream truck.

"Bumped into it?" He said in English.

Gu Cheng, the installer, replied in broken English: "SOrrySOrry...I was reversing and didn't pay attention...You see how much the broken area costs, I'll pay for it..."

As he spoke, he took a step forward, pointed to the recessed position of the bumper, and leaned forward——

Maxim Simon's eyes subconsciously followed the direction of his finger and glanced down slightly.

Just this one look.

Gu Chengan moved.

His left hand was pulled out of his trouser pocket more than ten times faster than the vague words in his mouth - his five fingers were wrapped around the back of the opponent's neck, his thumbs were accurately pressed on both sides of the medulla oblongata, and at the same time, he took a half-step forward with his right foot, pushing his knee into the opponent's inner thigh, destroying the center of gravity.

Marc Simon's reaction was really fast - his body began to retreat in the first few tenths of a second when he was touched, and his right elbow pushed outward simultaneously, trying to open up the distance.

But Gu Chengan was faster.

Genetic peak physique is not an abstract concept. It means that the contraction speed of each muscle fiber and the force intensity of each joint are optimized to the biological limit.

Marc Simon's elbow hit the air - because Gu Chengan's body was already close to him, his whole body was driven into the opponent's defensive gap like a nail, his right arm passed through the opponent's armpit from below, and his backhand locked the shoulder joint.

Not even a second.

Mark Simon was pressed face down on the body of the ice cream truck.

Gu Chengan freed up his right hand, took out his old friend from the system space - an ether towel and covered his mouth and nose directly.

The other party kept resisting while holding his breath.

The professionalism is really high. The first reaction of ordinary people when their mouth and nose are covered is to struggle to breathe, but trained people will hold their breath first to avoid inhaling volatile drugs.

Gu Chengan had expected it.

He was not in a hurry. The other party was unable to move under his full suppression. He placed the towel tightly on the other party's nose and mouth with his right hand, and then waited.

How long can a person hold his breath?Thirty to forty-five seconds for an ordinary person, and a person with good physical fitness can last just over a minute.

But what about a minute later?

Biological instincts take over, the diaphragm contracts uncontrollably, and air—and the ether in it—is forced into the lungs.

In addition, Gu Chengan's legs and knees stabbed his waist hard.

In the end it lasted less than thirty seconds.

Maxim Simon's body convulsed once, then twitched violently twice, and then went soft as if his skeleton had been emptied out.
